types.name: Fenrir::BoneName
types.doc: A bone's engine name as a component field (ADR-0037): a fixed 256-byte UTF-8 buffer, like `Name`, holding at most 255 bytes and a terminator. `Set` refuses a longer name rather than truncating it, since a truncated name could match another bone. A buffer written raw with no terminator is malformed: `Get` gives nothing, and an attachment naming it is diagnosed and never resolved.

fields.name: m_bytes
fields.doc: The bytes, zero-terminated when well-formed.

types.name: Fenrir::Entity
types.doc: Entity class that is used to interact with the entity list. This forms the basis of the ECS

types.name: Fenrir::HumanoidBones
types.doc: The humanoid bone map: the bone of a rig that fills each slot, by engine name, for `DescribeHumanoid`. Any slot may be empty: an empty slot drops its part and every part of the chain below it (an empty spine drops the chest, head and arms). The derivation never guesses a slot from a name.

fields.name: hips
fields.doc: The root of the map: every other slot hangs from it.

fields.name: spine
fields.doc: Below the hips.

fields.name: chest
fields.doc: Below the spine; the arms hang from it.

fields.name: head
fields.doc: Below the chest.

fields.name: leftUpperArm
fields.doc: Below the chest.

fields.name: leftLowerArm
fields.doc: Below the left upper arm: the elbow is a hinge.

fields.name: leftHand
fields.doc: Below the left lower arm.

fields.name: rightUpperArm
fields.doc: Below the chest.

fields.name: rightLowerArm
fields.doc: Below the right upper arm: the elbow is a hinge.

fields.name: rightHand
fields.doc: Below the right lower arm.

fields.name: leftUpperLeg
fields.doc: Below the hips.

fields.name: leftLowerLeg
fields.doc: Below the left upper leg: the knee is a hinge.

fields.name: leftFoot
fields.doc: Below the left lower leg; its bone's first child gives the forward direction.

fields.name: rightUpperLeg
fields.doc: Below the hips.

fields.name: rightLowerLeg
fields.doc: Below the right upper leg: the knee is a hinge.

fields.name: rightFoot
fields.doc: Below the right lower leg.

types.name: Fenrir::RagdollMode
types.doc: How a ragdoll's bodies move (ADR-0054). Game code writes it; the ragdoll glue applies it each tick.

values.name: Following
values.doc: Every body kinematic, moved each tick to its bone in the simulation pose × its offset: the character's hit boxes.

values.name: Simulating
values.doc: Every body dynamic, the glue writing each body's pose into the skeleton as a world pose override.

values.name: Powered
values.doc: Dynamic, with each joint's motor driving towards the base pose at `Ragdoll::strength`.

types.name: Fenrir::RagdollState
types.doc: What the ragdoll glue found last tick. Glue-owned: a write to it is overwritten next tick.

fields.name: anyAwake
fields.doc: Whether any body the glue drives is awake.

fields.name: bodies
fields.doc: How many bodies the glue drives this tick: its ragdoll bodies that were not skipped.

fields.name: inactive
fields.doc: Whether the ragdoll is inactive: its entity has no ready, tick-posed `SkeletonPose`.

types.name: Fenrir::Ragdoll
types.doc:
A ragdoll (ADR-0053): on the skeleton entity (the `SkeletonPose` entity), so a skeleton has at most one. Its bodies are ordinary rigid body and collider entities, each with a `RagdollBody` naming this entity, joined by ordinary `Joint` entities. `BuildRagdoll` makes them and this component; game code writes `mode` (and each body's own `mode`), the ragdoll glue turns it into motion types and motors each tick (ADR-0054).

A ragdoll needs a tick-posed skeleton (`SkeletonPose::timing == PoseTiming::Tick`, ADR-0040), and the glue never sets it: on a frame-posed or not-ready skeleton the ragdoll is inactive, writes nothing and warns once.

The glue owns the bodies' `RigidBody::motionType`, following bodies' `Transform` and velocities, the joints' motor modes and targets, the skeleton entity's `Transform` while it follows the root body, and the skeleton's pose override entries: a write to any of them is overwritten next tick. `state` is the glue's too.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: How every body moves, unless a body's own `mode` says otherwise. Switching moves no body. While a body simulates, its bone is drawn where the body is only as far as the bone's override weight says, and the glue never sets weights (ADR-0038): set the weights to 1 when you drop, ramp them to 0 as you get up (`Skeletons::SetOverrideWeight`, on the subtree for a partial ragdoll). Once every body follows and every weight reads 0, the glue clears its override entries.

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: How hard powered bodies' motors drive, in [0, 1]: read while `Powered` only.

fields.name: followRoot
fields.doc: Whether the skeleton entity follows the root body horizontally and in yaw while the root body is not following, keeping its height.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: The collision group the builder gave the bodies; informational: the bodies' own `CollisionGroup`s are what physics reads.

fields.name: rootBody
fields.doc: The root part's body entity: the hips' for a humanoid.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: What the glue found last tick. Glue-owned.

types.name: Fenrir::RagdollBodyMode
types.doc: A ragdoll body's own mode: its ragdoll's (`Inherit`), or one of the three, so a subtree of bodies can differ from its ragdoll (a partial ragdoll, ADR-0054).

types.name: Fenrir::RagdollBodyState
types.doc: What the ragdoll glue found for one body last tick. Glue-owned: a write to it is overwritten next tick.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: The mode in effect: the body's own, or its ragdoll's while the body's is `Inherit`.

fields.name: bone
fields.doc: The bone the body's name resolved to, or `NoBone` (-1) while it is skipped. A literal, since the API description records literal defaults only.

types.name: Fenrir::Transform
types.doc: An entity's place in the world, relative to its parent: every entity has one.

fields.name: pos
fields.doc: The position, relative to the parent.

fields.name: rot
fields.doc: The rotation, relative to the parent.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: The scale on each axis, relative to the parent.

types.name: Fenrir::RagdollBody
types.doc:
A ragdoll body (ADR-0053): on each body entity (a `RigidBody` plus `Collider` entity), naming its ragdoll and the bone it follows and drives, by name, with the body's pose relative to that bone.

While following, the glue writes the body's `Transform` as the bone's simulation-pose world matrix × `offset`; while simulating it writes the bone's world override target as the body × `offset`⁻¹. The offset is the builder's, from the skeleton asset's rest pose, and the glue never recalibrates it: a rest-pose change in the asset leaves it stale until the ragdoll is rebuilt. A body whose bone name matches nothing, whose entity has no `RigidBody`, or whose `ragdoll` is not a live `Ragdoll` entity of its scene is skipped with one warning, and its `state.bone` is `NoBone`.

A raycast or contact naming a ragdoll body names its bone through `bone`: ragdoll bodies are the character's hit boxes.

fields.name: ragdoll
fields.doc: The skeleton entity carrying the `Ragdoll`: explicit, never "my parent".

fields.name: bone
fields.doc: The bone this body follows and drives, by engine name.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: The body's pose relative to its bone.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: This body's own mode, or its ragdoll's.

fields.name: strengthScale
fields.doc: Multiplies `Ragdoll::strength` for this body's joint to its parent while powered.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: What the glue found last tick. Glue-owned.
